overview.description: The AllianzIM International Equity Buffer15 Uncapped Jul ETF (JULI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in enhanced growth alternatives. The fund seeks to track international developed equity price returns with a 15% downside buffer over a defined outcome period from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027. The fund uses options to limit losses within the buffer while participating in gains above a set threshold. JULI was launched on Jul 1, 2026 and is issued by Allianz.
